name: Monte Carlo

frame.name: Monte Carlo Method
frame.description: Dealing damage with this weapon reduces your melee cooldown and grants a chance to fully charge your melee ability with each kill.

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.description:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.description:
Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Markov Chain
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon. Melee kills grant ammo for this weapon.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: There will always be paths to tread and methods to try. Roll with it.

catalyst.name: Monte Carlo Catalyst
catalyst.description: At 5 stacks of Markov Chain, [Alternate Weapon Action]  - switches between your melee attack and Monte Carlo's bayonet. Landing a bayonet melee hit grants melee energy.
